title: Plasma Sphere Portrait
description: A woman with long flowing red hair is visible inside a large transparent plasma globe. Her face is centrally positioned behind a glowing red orb with multicolored electrical tendrils in neon green, purple, blue and yellow arcing outward to the glass surface.
prompt: A beautiful woman with long vibrant red hair and striking eyes is trapped inside a giant plasma globe, her face centered behind a glowing red central orb. Bright multicolored plasma tendrils in neon green, purple, blue and yellow arc from the orb to the glass sphere surface. The globe sits on a dark pedestal labeled PLASMA. Background features soft pink sky, floating blue orbs, misty mountains and pine trees, in a dreamy surreal fantasy style.
